description: Source code implementing SHA1-HMAC cryptographic functions for the Linux kernel, including context management, key setting, transformation, and finalization, specifically for the Infineon Technologies DEU module.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_transform
methods.description: Stores input block into context, with workaround for dbn size.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_setkey
methods.description: Sets the HMAC key, hashing if longer than max length.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_setkey_hw
methods.description: Loads the HMAC key into hardware registers.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_init
methods.description: Initializes the HMAC context before processing.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_update
methods.description: Processes input data for HMAC computation.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_final
methods.description: Finalizes HMAC computation and produces output.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_final_impl
methods.description: Performs final or intermediate HMAC hash calculation.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_exit_tfm
methods.description: Frees resources allocated for transformation context.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_sha1_hmac
methods.description: Registers the SHA1 HMAC driver with the crypto API.
